utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but did you all pick the next read yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great — thanks. I’ll be there Thursday at the cafe, so I’d love to hear what you all settle on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on the exact time, but I’ll text you both as soon as I hear back. Then we can send out the book details too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes—let’s go with Thursday at the cafe. That should work better with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, Thursday at the cafe works for me too — I’d have forgotten the change otherwise. Same book, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just send the options when you have them, and I’ll pick one and mark Thursday at 7 at the cafe on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes please — could you send the mystery title?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll tell everyone Thursday at the cafe, and I’m aiming for 6 pm. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, 6 pm works for me at the cafe. Thanks for passing it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’d love to know the book once it’s set. Thursday at the cafe works better for me, so just send the final details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for the final details.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Definitely — I can bring a few good options Thursday, and we can narrow it down together at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — Thursday at the cafe, and we’re reading *The Book of Goose*.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — Thursday at the cafe works, and *The Book of Goose* is a lovely pick. Let’s confirm the discussion time together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good to me — what time should we set?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll let everyone know Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll send the final time and book once we’ve nailed them down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Leo — once I have the times, I’ll help map out the driving days.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m good with Thursday at the cafe, but I still need the exact time and the book before I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you remind me of the exact time and which book we’re reading?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — Thursday at 6:30 at the cafe works for me. Send the invite when you can!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but did they pick the next read yet? And I’m glad it’s Thursday at the cafe — I just need the time too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks — I’ll go with Monday and Wednesday, and I won’t bring anything. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait — I think I’m still missing the time; did you mean Monday and Wednesday for something else? I only heard the book club moved to Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thank you — "The Book of Goose". And yes, please remind me when and where we’re meeting too; I keep mixing that up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep—book club’s moved to Thursday at the cafe, and I’m still checking the exact time. I’ll text you as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’ll probably forget again by tomorrow, so your text will save me!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep — we’re reading *The Book of Goose*, and we meet Thursday at the cafe now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Thursday at the cafe it is. I’ll plan on 6 and let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — 6 at the cafe works, and thanks for letting everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell the book club it’s Thursday at the cafe and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — that’s exactly right. If you can also mention the new pick when it’s set, I’ll keep the location note updated.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the Thursday cafe change and share the new pick once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re set for Thursday at the cafe, and the book is *The Thursday Murder Club*.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still on for Thursday at the cafe, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — still Thursday at the cafe, and we’re reading *The Thursday Murder Club*.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at the cafe is fine—just give me the time and the book, and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — we’re meeting Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll bring the book details next time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll wait for the book details next time, and I’ll mark Thursday at the cafe on my calendar.
